messages.subject: object from Rdata file appears missing after deploying to ShinyApps
messages.subject_clean: object from Rdata file appears missing after deploying to ShinyApps
messages.body_plain:
Hello

I have just started developing a Shiny app that incorporates rCharts/leaflet to display information related to animal telemetry and habitat use.

You can find the deployed application here: https://jmlondon.shinyapps.io/crawl_toolbox/

and, the source is available on Github here: https://github.com/NMML/crawl_toolbox

For this development phase, I am just relying on two datasets (harbor seal and northern fur seal) provided within the crawl package. To reduce the computation needed, I've gone ahead and fit the data to a movement model and stored the model prediction output for each example dataset into a single *.Rdata file. At this point, the main analysis task is creating kernel density polygons within adehabitatHR and the rest of the code is converting the sp objects to geojson and passing that on to leaflet.

When running the app locally, it's certainly not the fastest user experience but it works and seems to work reliably. However, after deploying to shinyapps.io <http://shinyapps.io>, only the harbor seal example appears to work. I noticed a few discussions regarding the application instance size, so I bumped it up to xxlarge and, still, only the harbor seal example works.

The *.Rdata file is 1.1MB and the geojson data ranges from 16kb to 820kb, but there isn't a pattern in file size to points to the northern fur seal data being too large. The javascript console in Chrome doesn't throw any errors and present any obvious issues that I can find. The only thought I have is that the harbor seal object (hs_predObj) sorts alphabetically ahead of the northern fur seal object (nfs_predObj).

So, I'm just reaching out to get some feedback and sort out what might be causing this issue.

cheers
Josh
